review:
Smokey in a spooky castle, on a cluster grid with a progressive Symbol Bar. Fill the bar for extra free spins and Rainbows, and reach its fourth level in the bonus for the biggest rewards.

The numbers stand out: a top RTP of 97% – among the best of any Hacksaw game – with 96%, 94%, 92% and 86% versions casinos can pick, so check the info screen. Rated 3/5 with a 15,000x max. Great for Le fans who want a higher ceiling.
